single_change: Replace random non-residual channel fusion by an identity bypass of the pretrained power token plus the same mixer's zero-initialized learned correction. Parameter count, RNG draw count, inputs, scalers, labels, loss, LR, epochs and selection rule are unchanged.
pretrain_reuse: Reuse exact corresponding completed v20 pretrain, never retrain it or load v20 finetune weights.
inner_epoch_selection: Same original-scale MAE early stopping as v20, no alternate checkpoint choice.

outer_gate.scope: Chronological internal selection only; no new outer predictions before the gate
outer_gate.if_failed: Complete the training-only experiment with no outer evaluation and retain the negative result
outer_gate.if_passed: Evaluate the exact candidates in all three folds, including any internally harmed fold, with no outer-based fallback

claim_scope: Falsifiable numerical-transfer engineering hypothesis, not a novel Wiki contribution or independent confirmation. No appended thresholds, seeds or hyperparameter search.
